text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear pro position from opening to conclusion","quality":"thesis consistency","description":"The essay maintains a clear, steady argument in favor of driverless cars throughout instead of wavering or drifting off position."},{"evidence":"paragraphs on fuel savings, safety, and passenger benefits","quality":"idea development","description":"The essay develops multiple supporting points rather than relying on a few brief assertions."},{"evidence":"mentions Sergey Brin, half a million miles, alert systems, and construction zones","quality":"textual support","description":"The essay uses several details from the source article to ground its claims in evidence."},{"evidence":"connects driverless cars to reduced texting-and-driving risk and safer transportation","quality":"reasoned explanation","description":"The essay explains how the evidence supports the claim, showing more logical elaboration than simple statement of opinion."},{"evidence":"counterargument paragraph beginning 'Many people have reason to believe...'", "quality":"counterargument handling","description":"The essay acknowledges objections and responds to them, which makes the argument more balanced and persuasive."},{"evidence":"introduction, body paragraphs, and concluding summary","quality":"organization","description":"The essay has a more complete and recognizable argumentative structure that helps the reader follow the line of reasoning."}]}
